conditions.meaning: Reports whether the installation has a valid entitlement, including a still-valid entitlement after a failed renewal.
Reports whether the last activation or renewal check succeeded, including a check before renewal is due.

example.introduction: The activation or renewal check succeeded.
example.nextCheck: Inspect status.renewAfter and status.expiresAt. The controller clears the DNS challenge fields after successful activation.
example.title: Installation entitlement active

outcomes.guidance: Check license server connectivity and installation credentials. If the message requests DNS verification, publish the TXT record in status.dnsName and status.dnsValue.
The installation has a valid entitlement. Check status.renewAfter and status.expiresAt.
Read the condition message. A previous entitlement can remain active until status.expiresAt.
Activation or the renewal check completed successfully. Inspect status.renewAfter for the next renewal.
